title: Prove the P104 reader-497 two-cache cost floor (no new kappa)
body:
Scoped proof and exact certificate: on PR6167, retaining each of reader 497's two operands in a separate descending owned cache cannot improve the existing schedule. For H_r=r^t, 0<t<1, the exact minimum is 2H_1+2H_3+H_5. Moving the root meeting below frame 520 costs at least 2H_4-H_3-H_5>0. A general all-dimension concavity proof explains the obstruction.

New relative to the #6167/#6214 handoff: both operands are retained and every cache MOVE is charged, with arbitrary intermediate frames. This differs from Nick Petalas's #6163 missing-operand/receiver-repair obstruction and #6245's outer audit. A changed-incidence positive control becomes cheaper, identifying the essential hypothesis.

Base: 2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc (priority 8; canonical main rechecked).
Source #6167: 564a076b113621a93edc4e39968ee4e4a8c9caf0.
Word SHA256: 68d1ff048bc6d30d85ceaeb38e2557adab87b20a9c67cf73948f95f54104575f.
[Published package, proof, pins and validation](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/9aaf76f43493cd2392eaae248274c651f29bc28e/research/p104-reader497-cache-floor).

Reproduce from repository root (CPython 3.12, stdlib only):
```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-reader497-cache-floor
```
Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; both modes report 126 recipes, 52964 geometric triples, 13 controls.

Executed: normal/-O registered replay; all 126 local symbolic templates (2006 events); exact capped-sum checks; changed-geometry positive control; 13 rejection controls; source and receipt corruption rejection; committed bytes/modes/ancestry; official export and Git-free normal/-O replay. Published commit 9aaf76f43493cd2392eaae248274c651f29bc28e has the exact complete tested tree.

Scope: monotone paths, separate caches, fixed sources/consumer and productive targets; ordinary setup/storage/erasure is optimistically free. Mixed sources, root cloning and coordinated edits remain open. No full native/caller/selected replay, hosted CI or formal/human proof acceptance is claimed. The five native, erasure, compiler, precision/tape and analytic-recovery assumptions remain. **No new κ.**

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
